baseline_models.focus_anchor: The decree-to construction, the book, the corruption clause, and the dual occurrence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A decisive communication is fixed in a binding record, and its content is two countable departures from proper order. The dual therefore bounds the forecast as two realizations rather than an indefinite habit.

activation_trace.role: Decisive conveyance supplies a formally delivered sentence rather than an incidental observation.
Binding inscription supplies the normative record in which the forecast is fixed.
Departure from fitness supplies the failure state realized in each event.
Counted temporal occurrence makes the dual two delimited realizations.

changed_reading.before: The verse predicts that corruption will happen twice.
changed_reading.after: A decisively communicated and binding record delimits two realizations of a breakdown from proper order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated emphatic clauses of corrupting in the earth and rising a great elevation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The elevation clause specifies a social form taken by the corruption clause: loss of order becomes self-magnifying domination, seizure, and competitive overcoming. The rise is therefore operative power over others, not only an inward attitude.

activation_trace.role: Loss of fitness supplies the damaged order that domination produces and exploits.
Blameworthy self-exaltation gives the rise its tyrannical social quality.
Overcoming and taking control turns vertical height into exercised domination.
Self-magnifying greatness intensifies the rise beyond ordinary advantage.
Competitive overcoming supplies the interpersonal force by which claimed greatness is enforced.

changed_reading.before: The second clause says that the addressees will become very arrogant.
changed_reading.after: The breakdown of order takes political form as self-magnifying domination and the active overcoming of others.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lineage designation, the book, and the departure from order.
baseline_models.mechanism: The literal lineage branch is overlaid with construction and joining branches from the same focus. This makes the addressed group an intergenerational order assembled through descent and inscription; corruption is then the disarticulation of something socially built.

activation_trace.role: Descent and attribution supply the literal intergenerational body addressed by the verse.
Construction by joining parts models that lineage as an assembled social order.
Joining and fastening supplies inscription as a second means of holding the collective together.
Departure from sound order supplies the failure of the assembled lineage structure.

changed_reading.before: A named people receives a prediction about its future misconduct.
changed_reading.after: An intergenerational order held together by descent and inscription is warned that its own assembled structure will depart from fitness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding book is a guide given to the same lineage, while the prohibition against another keeper closes off transferred sovereignty. The carried-lineage cue then makes the focus corruption a failure of inherited custody: an order meant to guide remains inscribed but is violated in practice.

activation_trace.role: Lineage and attribution anchor the changed reading in the focus addressee.
Binding inscription anchors the warning as part of an obligatory order.
Departure from fitness becomes the breach committed against that entrusted order.
The written-book branch makes the immediately preceding guide the medium in which the focus warning is lodged.
Gentle direction toward a right way supplies the intended function that corruption defeats.
The keeper branch, under negation, frames the guidance as refusing outsourced guardianship.
Bearing an entrusted burden overlays the carried ancestry with inherited responsibility.

structural_cues: 17:2 repeats both the book and the same lineage immediately before the focus.
17:3 identifies the addressees as a carried descent and places grateful servanthood beside that inheritance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies book-as-guidance, barred delegated guardianship, and carried descent; I infer a custodial breach, while the live alternative is that the book only records a prediction and carries no custody mechanism here.

changed_reading.before: The book is chiefly the location of a prediction.
changed_reading.after: The warning is lodged inside an entrusted guide, so corruption also reads as inherited custody failing its directing purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first event is rendered as dispatched force moving repeatedly through the gaps of inhabited space. This gives corruption in the earth a spatial mechanism: the social ground has become penetrable through its interior seams, so external force can traverse dwellings rather than merely confront a boundary.

activation_trace.role: Departure from sound order supplies the internal condition that the incursion exposes.
The lower inhabited ground supplies the spatial substrate through which the failure spreads.
Dispatch and directed sending supplies the incoming agent of penetration.
Repeated movement through dwellings supplies the incursion's interior path.
Gaps between things supply the channels through which the damaged order is traversed.
Affiliation with a dwelling anchors the penetration in resident social space rather than abstract territory.

structural_cues: 17:5 moves from the focus's broad earth to the interior of dwellings during the first appointed event.
The sequence is directional: dispatch is followed by probing through interior space.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatched agents, traversal, gaps, and dwellings; I infer that external penetration manifests an internally unfit social-spatial order, while the alternative is that the incursion is only a later punishment and not a disclosure of corruption's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Corruption in the earth is broad territorial wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Corruption is also a loss of civil and domestic integrity that leaves inhabited space traversable from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first event is bounded by an appointment, followed by a restored turn and connected reinforcement, and then by reciprocal return. The non-dominant counting branch resolved from the appointment root sharpens the sequence: the two occurrences form a feedback loop in which restored capacity enables renewed elevation and renewed response.

activation_trace.role: Two counted temporal realizations anchor the loop in the focus dual.
An appointment bounded by time or place gives the first phase a set threshold.
The split mapping's recurrent time count turns appointment into a repeated temporal mechanism.
Return to a prior position supplies reversal after the first defeat.
Return and repetition after a first occurrence gives the restored turn its cyclical shape.
Connected reinforcement supplies the renewed capacity that can feed the next rise.
Return after departure, doubled across both sides, closes the sequence as a reciprocal loop.

structural_cues: The context labels a first appointment, restores a turn with resources, then names a later appointment.
17:8 explicitly pairs renewed conduct with renewed response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, restoration, reinforcement, and reciprocal return; I infer that the second phase grows out of restored capacity, while the live alternative is two externally fixed episodes with no causal feedback between them.

changed_reading.before: Twice means two separate dates on which the same offense occurs.
changed_reading.after: Twice traces a resource-fed return loop: defeat, restored capacity, renewed elevation, and a corresponding renewed response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence enters the sanctuary, recalls the first occurrence, breaks apart what the addressees had risen over, and repeats the focus elevation root. The focus rise therefore acquires an occupiable institutional and territorial footprint that can be entered and dismantled, not merely an invisible feeling of pride.

activation_trace.role: Blameworthy self-exaltation anchors the later material footprint in the focus's censured rise.
Places of prostration establish the sacred spatial frame later re-entered by force.
Movement into an interior turns the consequence into an invasion of an occupiable structure.
The place of prostration locates the rise and its reversal in a sacred institution.
The recalled first occurrence explicitly ties the entry to the focus's counted pair.
Breaking, nullifying, and destroying supplies the reversal applied to the products of elevation.
The repeated root's domination branch makes what was risen over the scope of the dismantling.

structural_cues: 17:7 repeats the elevation root inside a sequence of entry and comprehensive breaking.
The phrase recalling the first occurrence binds that sequence to the focus dual.
The sanctuary in 17:7 echoes the paired sanctuaries that open the window.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sanctuary entry, recurrence, breaking, and a repeated elevation root; I infer that domination leaves an institutional or territorial structure behind, while the live alternative is that the later phrase denotes only whatever territory was overrun.

changed_reading.before: Great elevation is chiefly an attitude of extreme arrogance.
changed_reading.after: Great elevation becomes a dominative superstructure with a sacred and territorial footprint that a later reversal can enter and dismantle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The collective lineage address is decomposed by reflexive consequence, a record attached to each person, self-reckoning, and non-transferable burden. The twofold historical pattern can therefore remain collective without becoming indiscriminate collective guilt: it is assembled from acts that return to and remain with their agents.

activation_trace.role: The lineage branch anchors the large-scale collective addressed in the focus.
The self as the thing itself makes good and evil return to their own agents.
Binding and attaching a judgment supplies durable linkage between a person and the person's record.
Binding inscription turns personal action into an accountable record.
The self as one's own identity locates reckoning at the individual scale.
Counting and accounting supplies the operation by which the attached record is assessed.
A heavy carried burden supplies responsibility that cannot be shifted between persons.

structural_cues: 17:7 makes benefit and harm reflexive to the acting selves.
17:13-15 moves from each person's attached record to self-accounting and then denies transfer of burden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collective addressee plus self-returning deeds, attached records, and unshared burdens; I infer that the collective recurrence is emergent from individual accounts, while the alternative is that communal history and individual reckoning remain separate scales with no compositional claim.

changed_reading.before: The focus sounds like an undifferentiated collective sentence on a lineage.
changed_reading.after: The lineage bears a recurring historical pattern, but that pattern is composed of self-returning acts and individually attached, non-transferable accounts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counted time and fully separated detail lead into a book that is brought out, spread open, and read for reckoning. This revises the focus book from a passive container of prediction into an auditable recording architecture: the announced breakdown is both pre-inscribed as sentence and later legible through accumulated acts.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription anchors the focus warning in a record with normative force.
Enumeration supplies the temporal counting architecture that can distinguish the two occurrences.
Accounting converts counted time and action into assessable quantities.
Detailing parts and meanings supplies the record's granularity rather than a bare summary.
The written object supplies a concrete record produced for encounter and review.
An opened written record makes what was accumulated inspectable.
Reading and recitation supplies the act that turns inscription into disclosed evidence.
The repeated written-book branch links the disclosed personal record back to the focus book.

structural_cues: 17:12 joins counted years, accounting, and exhaustive detailing.
17:13-14 then presents a book, opens it to view, and commands its reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting, detail, a written object, opening, and reading; I infer one auditable record architecture around the focus book, while the live alternative is that the focus names communal scripture and the later book is an unrelated personal ledger.

changed_reading.before: The book passively contains a forecast about two future events.
changed_reading.after: The book participates in an auditable system in which a binding sentence and the detailed acts that realize it become mutually legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rapid chain moves from obligation through affluent release, boundary exit, a sentence becoming binding, and comprehensive destruction. This supplies an executable mechanism for the focus: corruption is a breach at the empowered center that converts an inscribed judgment from warning into realized consequence.

activation_trace.role: A made-complete and effectuated act supplies the decree's transition from statement to execution.
Binding inscription supplies the standing sentence that can become due.
Departure from fitness anchors the later boundary breach in the focus corruption.
Demand and obligation supplies the normative boundary presented to the town's empowered actors.
Abundance that releases its possessor identifies excess capacity as the pressure point in the chain.
A fruit exiting its protective shell supplies the material image of crossing the normative boundary.
A fixed and due obligation supplies the point at which the sentence takes hold.
Extirpating destruction supplies the terminal execution of the sequence.

structural_cues: 17:16 uses a tightly linked verbal sequence from command to elite violation to sentence to destruction.
The actors singled out at the breach point are the town's affluent members, not an undifferentiated population.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation, wealth-released actors, shell-exit, fixed liability, and destruction; I infer a causal execution chain, while the live alternative is that 17:16 states a general town pattern rather than unpacking the focus corruption.

changed_reading.before: Corruption is a broad moral label followed by an externally imposed punishment.
changed_reading.after: Corruption is an empowered boundary breach that makes the already inscribed sentence due and carries it into execution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same connected extension that restores power earlier is later generalized as provision to both groups without restriction. The repeated comparative greatness and stepwise degrees then regrade the focus elevation: visible power is a contingent allocation inside a larger hierarchy, not evidence that self-exaltation is deserved or final.

activation_trace.role: Blameworthy self-exaltation anchors the contingent provision model in the focus rise.
Magnitude supplies the greatness later subjected to explicit comparison and grading.
Connected reinforcement supplies the material extension from which renewed worldly height grows.
The repeated extension branch generalizes reinforcement beyond the earlier restored party.
Giving and handing over supplies worldly capacity as received provision rather than self-originated status.
The prohibition branch, under negation, makes that provision unrestricted across the contrasted recipients.
Rank and excellence supply the explicit comparative scale against which elevation is reassessed.
Repeated comparative magnitude relocates ultimate greatness beyond the focus's worldly rise.
Step-by-step degrees supply a graded hierarchy that contains and relativizes visible height.

structural_cues: The reinforcement root appears both in the restored power of 17:6 and the provision extended to both groups in 17:20.
17:21 repeats a comparative form of greatness around explicit degrees and preference.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common provision, repeated extension, comparative magnitude, and degrees; I infer that the focus rise is granted and reversible rather than self-validating, while the alternative is that censured elevation and later legitimate preference are only contrasts and share no allocation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The great rise appears as a self-produced peak of worldly superiority.
changed_reading.after: The rise is borrowed capacity within a larger grading system, so its magnitude is contingent, reversible, and no proof of deserved rank.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates rare material branches under the ordinary earth expression; it remains anchored in the focus's direct coupling of corruption, earth, and ascent, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy and never as the lexical translation of earth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Corruption in the earth followed by a conspicuous rise.

activation_trace.role: Departure from soundness supplies the general process of internal deterioration.
A wood-eating agent supplies the image of hidden consumption beneath an apparently standing structure.
A festering lesion supplies a second image of corruption spreading inside its substrate.
Visible ascent supplies the upper structure whose supporting ground is being hollowed out.

changed_reading.before: Territorial corruption and great ascent are two adjacent political claims.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the rise expands visibly while hidden consumption and festering hollow out the ground that supports it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses non-primary construction, joining, cord, and upper-load branches for forms whose immediate senses are lineage, book, twice, and rising; the shared focus roots keep the topology anchored, but downstream prose should label it a structural analogy rather than replace any surface sense with it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The built lineage, joined book, two occurrences, and great elevation within one focus sentence.

activation_trace.role: Construction by joining parts supplies a built collective capable of bearing a repeated pattern.
Joining and fastening consolidates the two events into one inscribed structure.
A tightly twisted cord models the two occurrences as mutually reinforcing strands rather than isolated points.
A load carried above supplies the elevated structure borne by the paired strands.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists two corruptions and then a great rise.
changed_reading.after: As a contained structural analogy, the two corruptions are tightly twisted strands that jointly bear and intensify one elevated order.

strongest_changes: The dual becomes a resource-fed return loop rather than two isolated dates.
The great elevation acquires an institutional and territorial footprint that later entry and breaking can dismantle.
The book becomes both entrusted guidance and an auditable record that connects sentence, action, and reckoning.
The collective historical pattern is decomposed into self-returning acts and non-transferable individual accounts.
Later common provision and comparative degrees regrade worldly elevation as contingent rather than self-validating.
summary.what_was_special: The most diagnostic activation came from the appointment root's split mapping into recurrent counting, reinforced by the return vocabulary, the direct reappearance of the elevation root inside the destruction sequence, and the later chain of counting, detailing, opening, and reading a book.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus book may remain specifically communal scripture rather than sharing one record architecture with the later personal book.
The later object of breaking may be the full institutional footprint of domination or only whatever territory was overrun.
The two events may be a causal feedback loop or two appointed episodes whose internal relation is only sequential.
The substrate and twisted-cord outliers are analogical activations, not proposed lexical senses.
